dossiers.name: ASX Filings Analyst
dossiers.summary: A citation-first ASX company report analyst that produces weekly valuation watchlists from public filings and licensed market data.
dossiers.buyer: Australian retail investors and small research teams.
dossiers.evidence: Competitor review complete; public-source wedge identified; regulatory risk mapped.
dossiers.missing: Manual pilot with paying or high-intent users.

dossiers.name: Parent Volleyball Community
dossiers.summary: A team-centered parent coordination app focused on communication, attendance, fixtures, and lightweight community support.
dossiers.buyer: Local clubs, team managers, and parent groups.
dossiers.evidence: Prototype direction and competitor comparison exist.
dossiers.missing: Club pilot and weekly retention data.

dossiers.name: Idea Reputation Engine
dossiers.summary: A reputation layer that credits people for critiques, pivots, research, prototypes, and kill signals across the idea lifecycle.
dossiers.buyer: Open Frontier contributors, builders, founders, and investors.
dossiers.evidence: Fits the existing app/game store people-as-product model.

dossiers.name: School Transport Trust Layer
dossiers.summary: A trust and coordination layer for parents evaluating safe transport options for young children.
dossiers.buyer: Parents, schools, transport operators, and local service coordinators.
dossiers.evidence: Need area identified; risk profile documented.
